dialogue.text: Uh
dialogue.zh: 呃
dialogue.ja: ええと
dialogue.local: Uh
dialogue.en: Uh

dialogue.text: Oh My God...
dialogue.zh: 天啊...
dialogue.ja: なんてことだ...
dialogue.local: Oh My God...
dialogue.en: Oh My God...

dialogue.text: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
dialogue.zh: 兩千多年前，古代中國學者觀察了自然界的變化規律，包括氣候、季節的更替和天文現象。
dialogue.ja: 2000年以上前、古代の中国の学者たちは自然界の変化、気候、季節の移り変わり、そして天文学を観察しました。
dialogue.local: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
dialogue.en: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.

dialogue.text: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-year-old paths, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
dialogue.zh: 學者們測量並將太陽的年運動分成24個路徑，創造了24節氣，這些節氣用來指導古代中國的農業。
dialogue.ja: 学者たちは太陽の年間の動きを24の区間に分け、24節気を作り出しました。これは古代中国の農業を管理するために使われました。
dialogue.local: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-year-old paths, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
dialogue.en: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-year-old paths, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.

dialogue.text: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.
dialogue.zh: 直到今天，這項發明仍指導著數億中國人的生活和傳統。
dialogue.ja: 今日に至るまで、この発明は数億人の中国人の生活や伝統を導いています。
dialogue.local: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.
dialogue.en: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.

dialogue.text: Towards the end of September, it's the autumn equinox time.
dialogue.zh: 九月底左右，是秋分時節。
dialogue.ja: 9月の終わり頃は秋分の時期です。
dialogue.local: Towards the end of September, it's the autumn equinox time.
dialogue.en: Towards the end of September, it's the autumn equinox time.

dialogue.text: Day and night are equally long, summer and winter are equally far apart. Farmers are busy bringing in the harvest and every mid autumn festival, families get together for a bit of a new place.
dialogue.zh: 晝夜等長，夏季和冬季距離相等。農民忙著收割，每年中秋節，家人團聚享受新天地。
dialogue.ja: 昼と夜の長さが同じで、夏と冬が同じ距離にあります。農民は収穫に忙しく、毎年の中秋節には家族が集まって新しい場所で過ごします。
dialogue.local: Day and night are equally long, summer and winter are equally far apart. Farmers are busy bringing in the harvest and every mid autumn festival, families get together for a bit of a new place.
dialogue.en: Day and night are equally long, summer and winter are equally far apart. Farmers are busy bringing in the harvest and every mid autumn festival, families get together for a bit of a new place.

dialogue.text: The autumn equinox is midway through autumn and marks the beginning of deepest autumn.
dialogue.zh: 秋分是秋季的中點，標誌著深秋的開始。
dialogue.ja: 秋分は秋の真ん中で、深い秋の始まりを示します。
dialogue.local: The autumn equinox is midway through autumn and marks the beginning of deepest autumn.
dialogue.en: The autumn equinox is midway through autumn and marks the beginning of deepest autumn.

dialogue.text: The most obvious changes in the colour of the trees, their so vivid, they could be in an oil painting.
dialogue.zh: 樹葉顏色的變化最為明顯，色彩鮮豔得像油畫一樣。
dialogue.ja: 木々の色の変化が最も顕著で、その鮮やかさはまるで油絵のようです。
dialogue.local: The most obvious changes in the colour of the trees, their so vivid, they could be in an oil painting.
dialogue.en: The most obvious changes in the colour of the trees, their so vivid, they could be in an oil painting.

dialogue.text: After this solar term, there's no more thunder.
dialogue.zh: 這個節氣過後，就不再有雷聲了。
dialogue.ja: この節気の後は雷が鳴らなくなります。
dialogue.local: After this solar term, there's no more thunder.
dialogue.en: After this solar term, there's no more thunder.

dialogue.text: The insects that woke up in the third solar term dinghir are either dying or looking for a safe place to survive the winter.
dialogue.zh: 在第三節氣‘驚蟄’醒來的昆蟲，要麼死亡，要麼尋找安全的地方過冬。
dialogue.ja: 第三の節気「啓蟄」で目覚めた昆虫たちは、死にかけているか、冬を越す安全な場所を探しています。
dialogue.local: The insects that woke up in the third solar term dinghir are either dying or looking for a safe place to survive the winter.
dialogue.en: The insects that woke up in the third solar term dinghir are either dying or looking for a safe place to survive the winter.

dialogue.text: Sunhuang is in northwestern China, a transitional region between Bajangarang and Taklamakan deserts.
dialogue.zh: 敦煌位於中國西北部，是巴丹吉林沙漠和塔克拉瑪干沙漠之間的過渡地帶。
dialogue.ja: 敦煌は中国の北西部にあり、バダンジラン砂漠とタクラマカン砂漠の間の移行地帯です。
dialogue.local: Sunhuang is in northwestern China, a transitional region between Bajangarang and Taklamakan deserts.
dialogue.en: Sunhuang is in northwestern China, a transitional region between Bajangarang and Taklamakan deserts.

dialogue.text: It used to be on the main thoroughfare of the Silk Road Trade Route.
dialogue.zh: 它曾是絲綢之路貿易路線的主要通道。
dialogue.ja: かつてはシルクロード貿易ルートの主要な通り道でした。
dialogue.local: It used to be on the main thoroughfare of the Silk Road Trade Route.
dialogue.en: It used to be on the main thoroughfare of the Silk Road Trade Route.

dialogue.text: I came over here for autumn equinox solar term to explore deep into the hinterland of China and take in this incredible desert oasis.
dialogue.zh: 我來到這裡，為了秋分節氣，深入中國內陸，欣賞這片令人驚嘆的沙漠綠洲。
dialogue.ja: 秋分の節気に合わせてここに来て、中国の奥地を探検し、この素晴らしい砂漠のオアシスを楽しんでいます。
dialogue.local: I came over here for autumn equinox solar term to explore deep into the hinterland of China and take in this incredible desert oasis.
dialogue.en: I came over here for autumn equinox solar term to explore deep into the hinterland of China and take in this incredible desert oasis.

dialogue.text: You can imagine that ever since the hand dynasty of 2,200 years ago, European businessmen looking a bit like me have been here leading teams of camel transporting bundles of silk and other material from China around the world.
dialogue.zh: 你可以想像，從2200年前的漢朝開始，像我這樣的歐洲商人就在這裡，帶領駱駝隊將絲綢和其他物資從中國運往世界各地。
dialogue.ja: 2200年前の漢代以来、私のようなヨーロッパの商人がここにいて、ラクダの隊を率いて中国から世界中に絹やその他の物資を運んでいました。
dialogue.local: You can imagine that ever since the hand dynasty of 2,200 years ago, European businessmen looking a bit like me have been here leading teams of camel transporting bundles of silk and other material from China around the world.
dialogue.en: You can imagine that ever since the hand dynasty of 2,200 years ago, European businessmen looking a bit like me have been here leading teams of camel transporting bundles of silk and other material from China around the world.

dialogue.text: Massive wealth flowed along the Silk Road to China as well.
dialogue.zh: 大量財富也沿著絲綢之路流入中國。
dialogue.ja: 莫大な富がシルクロードを通じて中国にも流れ込みました。
dialogue.local: Massive wealth flowed along the Silk Road to China as well.
dialogue.en: Massive wealth flowed along the Silk Road to China as well.

dialogue.text: China at the time was one of the chief trading nations of the world.
dialogue.zh: 當時中國是世界主要的貿易國之一。
dialogue.ja: 当時の中国は世界の主要な貿易国の一つでした。
dialogue.local: China at the time was one of the chief trading nations of the world.
dialogue.en: China at the time was one of the chief trading nations of the world.

dialogue.text: Now Dunhuang has lost its pivotal positioning global trade, but this gobi desert is still a sacred place for Chinese people yearning for a distant past.
dialogue.zh: 如今敦煌已失去全球貿易的樞紐地位，但這片戈壁沙漠仍是中國人懷念遙遠過去的聖地。
dialogue.ja: 現在、敦煌は世界貿易の中心的地位を失いましたが、このゴビ砂漠は遠い過去を懐かしむ中国人にとって神聖な場所です。
dialogue.local: Now Dunhuang has lost its pivotal positioning global trade, but this gobi desert is still a sacred place for Chinese people yearning for a distant past.
dialogue.en: Now Dunhuang has lost its pivotal positioning global trade, but this gobi desert is still a sacred place for Chinese people yearning for a distant past.

dialogue.text: There's a rhyming couplet for this season when days and nights are just as long hard work just goes on and on.
dialogue.zh: 這個季節有一句押韻的對聯：晝夜等長，辛勤勞作不斷持續。
dialogue.ja: この季節には韻を踏んだ句があります。昼と夜が同じ長さで、勤勉な仕事が続きます。
dialogue.local: There's a rhyming couplet for this season when days and nights are just as long hard work just goes on and on.
dialogue.en: There's a rhyming couplet for this season when days and nights are just as long hard work just goes on and on.

dialogue.text: Long cycles are the farmers number one concern, so the solar terms are extraordinarily clear on planning and it is set that autumn equinox is when Dunhuang farmers will harvest their cotton.
dialogue.zh: 長周期是農民最關心的，因此節氣對計劃非常明確，秋分是敦煌農民收割棉花的時節。
dialogue.ja: 長い周期は農民の最重要課題であり、節気は計画に非常に明確で、秋分は敦煌の農民が綿花を収穫する時期と定められています。
dialogue.local: Long cycles are the farmers number one concern, so the solar terms are extraordinarily clear on planning and it is set that autumn equinox is when Dunhuang farmers will harvest their cotton.
dialogue.en: Long cycles are the farmers number one concern, so the solar terms are extraordinarily clear on planning and it is set that autumn equinox is when Dunhuang farmers will harvest their cotton.

dialogue.text: Dunhuang is surrounded by desert, so drought and water shortage is pretty common.
dialogue.zh: 敦煌被沙漠包圍，乾旱和缺水很常見。
dialogue.ja: 敦煌は砂漠に囲まれているため、干ばつや水不足がよくあります。
dialogue.local: Dunhuang is surrounded by desert, so drought and water shortage is pretty common.
dialogue.en: Dunhuang is surrounded by desert, so drought and water shortage is pretty common.

dialogue.text: Because of or in spite of this, it has become an important base for cotton production.
dialogue.zh: 正因如此，敦煌成為重要的棉花生產基地。
dialogue.ja: これが理由で、敦煌は重要な綿花生産基地となっています。
dialogue.local: Because of or in spite of this, it has become an important base for cotton production.
dialogue.en: Because of or in spite of this, it has become an important base for cotton production.

dialogue.text: This makes me think back to the Xiaoman solar term in Shenzhen where there was copious amounts of rain and the silkworms thrived, raising a whole industry of silk production.
dialogue.zh: 這讓我想起深圳的小滿節氣，那裡雨量充沛，蠶蟲茁壯，帶動了整個絲綢產業。
dialogue.ja: これで深圳の小満の節気を思い出します。そこでは雨が豊富で、蚕がよく育ち、絹の産業が発展しました。
dialogue.local: This makes me think back to the Xiaoman solar term in Shenzhen where there was copious amounts of rain and the silkworms thrived, raising a whole industry of silk production.
dialogue.en: This makes me think back to the Xiaoman solar term in Shenzhen where there was copious amounts of rain and the silkworms thrived, raising a whole industry of silk production.

dialogue.text: Such differences in regional climate have not limited Chinese creativity over time.
dialogue.zh: 這些地區氣候的差異並未限制中國人的創造力。
dialogue.ja: 地域ごとの気候の違いは、中国の創造力を制限しませんでした。
dialogue.local: Such differences in regional climate have not limited Chinese creativity over time.
dialogue.en: Such differences in regional climate have not limited Chinese creativity over time.

dialogue.text: The thousands of years, silk and cotton have warmed the backs of Chinese people in different parts of this vast land.
dialogue.zh: 數千年來，絲綢和棉花溫暖了這片廣大土地上中國人的背脊。
dialogue.ja: 何千年もの間、絹と綿はこの広大な土地の中国人の背中を温めてきました。
dialogue.local: The thousands of years, silk and cotton have warmed the backs of Chinese people in different parts of this vast land.
dialogue.en: The thousands of years, silk and cotton have warmed the backs of Chinese people in different parts of this vast land.

dialogue.text: Their inventions lie in a key climatic difference between north and south.
dialogue.zh: 他們的發明源於南北氣候的關鍵差異。
dialogue.ja: 彼らの発明は南北の気候の重要な違いにあります。
dialogue.local: Their inventions lie in a key climatic difference between north and south.
dialogue.en: Their inventions lie in a key climatic difference between north and south.

dialogue.text: This is one of the most important cotton production sites in China.
dialogue.zh: 這是中國最重要的棉花生產基地之一。
dialogue.ja: ここは中国で最も重要な綿花生産地の一つです。
dialogue.local: This is one of the most important cotton production sites in China.
dialogue.en: This is one of the most important cotton production sites in China.

dialogue.text: And it is also the largest coloured cotton testing station in the country.
dialogue.zh: 同時也是國內最大的彩色棉花試驗站。
dialogue.ja: また、国内最大のカラードコットン試験場でもあります。
dialogue.local: And it is also the largest coloured cotton testing station in the country.
dialogue.en: And it is also the largest coloured cotton testing station in the country.

dialogue.text: The autumn equinox is harvest season in the water-rich regions of China.
dialogue.zh: 秋分是中國水資源豐富地區的收穫季節。
dialogue.ja: 秋分は中国の水が豊富な地域の収穫期です。
dialogue.local: The autumn equinox is harvest season in the water-rich regions of China.
dialogue.en: The autumn equinox is harvest season in the water-rich regions of China.

dialogue.text: Farmers are harvesting rice and fruit around about now, but in Dunhuang, just look at the full light cotton balls that grow on this cracked and salty soil.
dialogue.zh: 農民們現在正在收割稻米和水果，但在敦煌，看看這些在龜裂鹹土上生長的飽滿棉花絮。
dialogue.ja: 農民たちは今頃、米や果物を収穫していますが、敦煌では、このひび割れた塩分の多い土壌で育つふっくらとした綿の実をご覧ください。
dialogue.local: Farmers are harvesting rice and fruit around about now, but in Dunhuang, just look at the full light cotton balls that grow on this cracked and salty soil.
dialogue.en: Farmers are harvesting rice and fruit around about now, but in Dunhuang, just look at the full light cotton balls that grow on this cracked and salty soil.

dialogue.text: You have to wonder at the plant's tenacity and how ancient civilizations across China adapted to local conditions.
dialogue.zh: 你不得不驚嘆這植物的生命力，以及古代中國文明如何適應當地環境。
dialogue.ja: この植物の生命力と、古代中国の文明がどのように地域の環境に適応したかに驚かされます。
dialogue.local: You have to wonder at the plant's tenacity and how ancient civilizations across China adapted to local conditions.
dialogue.en: You have to wonder at the plant's tenacity and how ancient civilizations across China adapted to local conditions.

dialogue.text: Having said that, cotton doesn't actually come from here.
dialogue.zh: 話說回來，棉花其實不是本地原產。
dialogue.ja: とはいえ、綿は実際にはここから来たものではありません。
dialogue.local: Having said that, cotton doesn't actually come from here.
dialogue.en: Having said that, cotton doesn't actually come from here.

dialogue.text: Once in 1,500 years ago, it was brought into the country by Camel Caravan, trundling along the Silk Road, introduced to Dunhuang from India and Arabia.
dialogue.zh: 大約1500年前，棉花由駱駝商隊沿絲綢之路從印度和阿拉伯引入敦煌。
dialogue.ja: 約1500年前、ラクダの隊商がシルクロードを通ってインドやアラビアから敦煌に綿を持ち込みました。
dialogue.local: Once in 1,500 years ago, it was brought into the country by Camel Caravan, trundling along the Silk Road, introduced to Dunhuang from India and Arabia.
dialogue.en: Once in 1,500 years ago, it was brought into the country by Camel Caravan, trundling along the Silk Road, introduced to Dunhuang from India and Arabia.

dialogue.text: 1,500 years later, cotton makes up to 70% of crops grown here.
dialogue.zh: 1500年後，棉花佔當地作物的70%。
dialogue.ja: 1500年後、綿はここで栽培される作物の70％を占めています。
dialogue.local: 1,500 years later, cotton makes up to 70% of crops grown here.
dialogue.en: 1,500 years later, cotton makes up to 70% of crops grown here.

dialogue.text: 60% of farmers' income is in some way connected to cotton.
dialogue.zh: 60%的農民收入與棉花有關。
dialogue.ja: 農民の収入の60％は何らかの形で綿に関連しています。
dialogue.local: 60% of farmers' income is in some way connected to cotton.
dialogue.en: 60% of farmers' income is in some way connected to cotton.

dialogue.text: Apart from all the cotton waiting to be harvested, there are also the forests of the gobi desert, coming into their own in autumn, for them it's the most beautiful season by far.
dialogue.zh: 除了等待收割的棉花，戈壁沙漠的森林在秋天也展現出最美的季節。
dialogue.ja: 収穫を待つ綿のほかに、ゴビ砂漠の森林も秋に最も美しい季節を迎えます。
dialogue.local: Apart from all the cotton waiting to be harvested, there are also the forests of the gobi desert, coming into their own in autumn, for them it's the most beautiful season by far.
dialogue.en: Apart from all the cotton waiting to be harvested, there are also the forests of the gobi desert, coming into their own in autumn, for them it's the most beautiful season by far.

dialogue.text: Poplar trees, because they can survive for thousands of years, the locals call them the heroes of the desert.
dialogue.zh: 白楊樹因能存活千年，被當地人稱為沙漠英雄。
dialogue.ja: ポプラの木は何千年も生きられるため、地元の人々は彼らを砂漠の英雄と呼びます。
dialogue.local: Poplar trees, because they can survive for thousands of years, the locals call them the heroes of the desert.
dialogue.en: Poplar trees, because they can survive for thousands of years, the locals call them the heroes of the desert.

dialogue.text: And this part of the gobi desert witnesses the most vibrant moment of the autumn equinox period.
dialogue.zh: 這片戈壁沙漠見證了秋分時期最生機勃勃的時刻。
dialogue.ja: このゴビ砂漠の一部は秋分の期間で最も活気ある瞬間を迎えます。
dialogue.local: And this part of the gobi desert witnesses the most vibrant moment of the autumn equinox period.
dialogue.en: And this part of the gobi desert witnesses the most vibrant moment of the autumn equinox period.

dialogue.text: For a while now, there's been a limited water supply on wheat days because it's been needed for irrigation.
dialogue.zh: 最近一段時間，因為灌溉需要，水供應在小麥生長期有限。
dialogue.ja: しばらくの間、小麦の時期には灌漑のために水の供給が限られていました。
dialogue.local: For a while now, there's been a limited water supply on wheat days because it's been needed for irrigation.
dialogue.en: For a while now, there's been a limited water supply on wheat days because it's been needed for irrigation.

dialogue.text: After harvest, farmers need less water and the nearby reservoir will be drained into the surrounding gobi desert.
dialogue.zh: 收割後，農民需要較少水，附近水庫的水會排入周圍的戈壁沙漠。
dialogue.ja: 収穫後、農民は水をあまり必要とせず、近くの貯水池の水が周囲のゴビ砂漠に流されます。
dialogue.local: After harvest, farmers need less water and the nearby reservoir will be drained into the surrounding gobi desert.
dialogue.en: After harvest, farmers need less water and the nearby reservoir will be drained into the surrounding gobi desert.

dialogue.text: Red willow and medicinal herb called camel-shap grow wild.
dialogue.zh: 紅柳和名為駱駝刺的藥用植物野生生長。
dialogue.ja: 赤柳とキャメルシャープという薬用植物が野生で育っています。
dialogue.local: Red willow and medicinal herb called camel-shap grow wild.
dialogue.en: Red willow and medicinal herb called camel-shap grow wild.

dialogue.text: These are the favorite foodstuffs of the precious two-humped, back-drin camel.
dialogue.zh: 這些是珍貴的雙峰駱駝最喜愛的食物。
dialogue.ja: これらは貴重な二峰ラクダの好物です。
dialogue.local: These are the favorite foodstuffs of the precious two-humped, back-drin camel.
dialogue.en: These are the favorite foodstuffs of the precious two-humped, back-drin camel.

dialogue.text: As long as 5,000 years ago, human beings living on the edge of the desert had domesticated the camel.
dialogue.zh: 早在五千年前，生活在沙漠邊緣的人類就已馴養駱駝。
dialogue.ja: 5000年前には、砂漠の端に住む人々がラクダを家畜化していました。
dialogue.local: As long as 5,000 years ago, human beings living on the edge of the desert had domesticated the camel.
dialogue.en: As long as 5,000 years ago, human beings living on the edge of the desert had domesticated the camel.

dialogue.text: Apart from providing camel fur and milk for humans, camels became the most important form of desert transportation, fully loaded, stepping out onto the silk road.
dialogue.zh: 除了提供駱駝毛和奶，駱駝成為沙漠中最重要的交通工具，滿載貨物踏上絲綢之路。
dialogue.ja: ラクダは毛皮やミルクを提供するだけでなく、砂漠で最も重要な交通手段となり、満載でシルクロードを進みました。
dialogue.local: Apart from providing camel fur and milk for humans, camels became the most important form of desert transportation, fully loaded, stepping out onto the silk road.
dialogue.en: Apart from providing camel fur and milk for humans, camels became the most important form of desert transportation, fully loaded, stepping out onto the silk road.

dialogue.text: On the first batch of cotton seeds and many other precious materials were loaded onto the back of a camel and driven along the endless silk road, human civilization opened a whole other chapter.
dialogue.zh: 第一批棉種和許多珍貴物資被裝上駱駝，沿著無盡的絲綢之路運送，人類文明開啟了全新篇章。
dialogue.ja: 最初の綿の種や多くの貴重な物資がラクダの背に積まれ、果てしないシルクロードを進み、人類文明は新たな章を開きました。
dialogue.local: On the first batch of cotton seeds and many other precious materials were loaded onto the back of a camel and driven along the endless silk road, human civilization opened a whole other chapter.
dialogue.en: On the first batch of cotton seeds and many other precious materials were loaded onto the back of a camel and driven along the endless silk road, human civilization opened a whole other chapter.

dialogue.text: At now, China has the fastest trains in the world, massive world-beating airports, and there's really no need to use camel caribalds anymore.
dialogue.zh: 如今中國擁有世界最快的列車和大型國際機場，已不再需要駱駝隊。
dialogue.ja: 現在、中国には世界最速の列車や巨大な空港があり、もはやラクダ隊を使う必要はありません。
dialogue.local: At now, China has the fastest trains in the world, massive world-beating airports, and there's really no need to use camel caribalds anymore.
dialogue.en: At now, China has the fastest trains in the world, massive world-beating airports, and there's really no need to use camel caribalds anymore.

dialogue.text: But in Dunhuang, the locals still keep up the tradition of having camels.
dialogue.zh: 但在敦煌，當地人仍保留著養駱駝的傳統。
dialogue.ja: しかし敦煌では、地元の人々は今もラクダを飼う伝統を守っています。
dialogue.local: But in Dunhuang, the locals still keep up the tradition of having camels.
dialogue.en: But in Dunhuang, the locals still keep up the tradition of having camels.

dialogue.text: The Crescent Village, it got its name because it's located next to an oasis that's shaped like a crescent.
dialogue.zh: 月牙村得名於其位於新月形綠洲旁。
dialogue.ja: クレセント村は、三日月形のオアシスのそばにあるためその名がつきました。
dialogue.local: The Crescent Village, it got its name because it's located next to an oasis that's shaped like a crescent.
dialogue.en: The Crescent Village, it got its name because it's located next to an oasis that's shaped like a crescent.

dialogue.text: The magic of this crescent moon oasis is that it's been surrounded by desert for thousands of years, but has never tried up.
dialogue.zh: 這個新月綠洲的神奇之處在於，千年來被沙漠包圍，卻從未乾涸。
dialogue.ja: この三日月形のオアシスの不思議なところは、何千年も砂漠に囲まれているのに、決して干上がらないことです。
dialogue.local: The magic of this crescent moon oasis is that it's been surrounded by desert for thousands of years, but has never tried up.
dialogue.en: The magic of this crescent moon oasis is that it's been surrounded by desert for thousands of years, but has never tried up.

dialogue.text: It looks like every villager in the Crescent Village is an expert in raising camels.
dialogue.zh: 看起來月牙村的每個村民都是養駱駝的專家。
dialogue.ja: クレセント村の村人は皆、ラクダの飼育の専門家のようです。
dialogue.local: It looks like every villager in the Crescent Village is an expert in raising camels.
dialogue.en: It looks like every villager in the Crescent Village is an expert in raising camels.

dialogue.text: Every tourist season, the camels in the village become the main means of transportation in Dunhuang.
dialogue.zh: 每到旅遊旺季，村裡的駱駝成為敦煌的主要交通工具。
dialogue.ja: 観光シーズンには、村のラクダが敦煌の主要な交通手段になります。
dialogue.local: Every tourist season, the camels in the village become the main means of transportation in Dunhuang.
dialogue.en: Every tourist season, the camels in the village become the main means of transportation in Dunhuang.

dialogue.text: Thousands of tourists come here, almost everyone wants to ride a camel.
dialogue.zh: 成千上萬的遊客來此，幾乎人人都想騎駱駝。
dialogue.ja: 何千もの観光客がここに来て、ほとんど全員がラクダに乗りたがります。
dialogue.local: Thousands of tourists come here, almost everyone wants to ride a camel.
dialogue.en: Thousands of tourists come here, almost everyone wants to ride a camel.

dialogue.text: To get a feel for what crossing the desert, silk road is really likely.
dialogue.zh: 體驗穿越沙漠和絲綢之路的真實感受。
dialogue.ja: 砂漠やシルクロードを渡る感覚を味わうためです。
dialogue.local: To get a feel for what crossing the desert, silk road is really likely.
dialogue.en: To get a feel for what crossing the desert, silk road is really likely.

dialogue.text: The autumn tourist season is around a time of China's national day holiday.
dialogue.zh: 秋季旅遊旺季正值中國國慶假期。
dialogue.ja: 秋の観光シーズンは中国の国慶節の頃です。
dialogue.local: The autumn tourist season is around a time of China's national day holiday.
dialogue.en: The autumn tourist season is around a time of China's national day holiday.

dialogue.text: The villagers of the Crescent Village are preparing for their most lucrative time of the year.
dialogue.zh: 月牙村的村民正在準備一年中最賺錢的時刻。
dialogue.ja: クレセント村の村人たちは一年で最も儲かる時期の準備をしています。
dialogue.local: The villagers of the Crescent Village are preparing for their most lucrative time of the year.
dialogue.en: The villagers of the Crescent Village are preparing for their most lucrative time of the year.

dialogue.text: Extremely lucky.
dialogue.zh: 非常幸運。
dialogue.ja: とても幸運です。
dialogue.local: Extremely lucky.
dialogue.en: Extremely lucky.

dialogue.text: As the village is close to scenic sites popular with visitors, it's easy to take people there by camel caravan.
dialogue.zh: 村子靠近遊客喜愛的風景區，駱駝隊帶遊客前往十分方便。
dialogue.ja: 村は観光客に人気の景勝地の近くにあり、ラクダの隊商で簡単に人々を連れて行けます。
dialogue.local: As the village is close to scenic sites popular with visitors, it's easy to take people there by camel caravan.
dialogue.en: As the village is close to scenic sites popular with visitors, it's easy to take people there by camel caravan.

dialogue.text: They can easily earn a lot from tourism.
dialogue.zh: 他們可以輕鬆從旅遊業賺取豐厚收入。
dialogue.ja: 彼らは観光業で簡単に多く稼げます。
dialogue.local: They can easily earn a lot from tourism.
dialogue.en: They can easily earn a lot from tourism.

dialogue.text: Regardless of the farmers who grow cotton, or the camel herders making good business from visitors, or the many tourists who come from all over the world, camels have long been a symbol of Dunhuang.
dialogue.zh: 無論是種棉花的農民、靠遊客做生意的駱駝牧民，還是來自世界各地的遊客，駱駝長久以來一直是敦煌的象徵。
dialogue.ja: 綿を育てる農民も、観光客相手に商売をするラクダ飼いも、世界中から来る多くの観光客も、ラクダは長い間敦煌の象徴でした。
dialogue.local: Regardless of the farmers who grow cotton, or the camel herders making good business from visitors, or the many tourists who come from all over the world, camels have long been a symbol of Dunhuang.
dialogue.en: Regardless of the farmers who grow cotton, or the camel herders making good business from visitors, or the many tourists who come from all over the world, camels have long been a symbol of Dunhuang.

dialogue.text: Right after the autumn equinox is China's national day holiday.
dialogue.zh: 秋分過後就是中國的國慶假期。
dialogue.ja: 秋分のすぐ後が中国の国慶節の休日です。
dialogue.local: Right after the autumn equinox is China's national day holiday.
dialogue.en: Right after the autumn equinox is China's national day holiday.

dialogue.text: Apart from the spring festival, it's the longest stretch of holiday in China.
dialogue.zh: 除了春節，這是中國最長的連續假期。
dialogue.ja: 春節を除けば、中国で最も長い連続休暇です。
dialogue.local: Apart from the spring festival, it's the longest stretch of holiday in China.
dialogue.en: Apart from the spring festival, it's the longest stretch of holiday in China.

dialogue.text: This is peak season for seeing Dunhuang.
dialogue.zh: 這是觀賞敦煌的旅遊旺季。
dialogue.ja: これは敦煌を見るのに最も良い季節です。
dialogue.local: This is peak season for seeing Dunhuang.
dialogue.en: This is peak season for seeing Dunhuang.

dialogue.text: Almost everyone who comes here will take a model camel home with them.
dialogue.zh: 幾乎所有來這裡的人都會帶一隻駱駝模型回家。
dialogue.ja: ここに来るほとんどの人がラクダの模型を持ち帰ります。
dialogue.local: Almost everyone who comes here will take a model camel home with them.
dialogue.en: Almost everyone who comes here will take a model camel home with them.

dialogue.text: Zhang Jian Dong used to be a Dunhuang cotton farmer, but now he goes by the name camel Zhang.
dialogue.zh: 張建東曾是敦煌的棉農，現在被稱為駱駝張。
dialogue.ja: 張建東はかつて敦煌の綿農家でしたが、今はラクダ張と呼ばれています。
dialogue.local: Zhang Jian Dong used to be a Dunhuang cotton farmer, but now he goes by the name camel Zhang.
dialogue.en: Zhang Jian Dong used to be a Dunhuang cotton farmer, but now he goes by the name camel Zhang.

dialogue.text: He himself grew cotton for more than 20 years, but when he got the idea of making camels for tourists, his life changed course completely, and he made people see Dunhuang a whole other way.
dialogue.zh: 他自己種了20多年棉花，但當他想到為遊客製作駱駝模型時，人生完全改變，讓人們以全新視角看敦煌。
dialogue.ja: 彼は20年以上綿を育てましたが、観光客向けにラクダを作るアイデアを思いついたとき、人生が一変し、人々に敦煌を全く違う見方で見せました。
dialogue.local: He himself grew cotton for more than 20 years, but when he got the idea of making camels for tourists, his life changed course completely, and he made people see Dunhuang a whole other way.
dialogue.en: He himself grew cotton for more than 20 years, but when he got the idea of making camels for tourists, his life changed course completely, and he made people see Dunhuang a whole other way.

dialogue.text: In order to meet the needs of his customers, Zhang Jian Dong designs 36 kinds, all different styles of camel craft.
dialogue.zh: 為了滿足顧客需求，張建東設計了36種不同風格的駱駝工藝品。
dialogue.ja: 顧客のニーズに応えるため、張建東は36種類の異なるスタイルのラクダ工芸品をデザインしました。
dialogue.local: In order to meet the needs of his customers, Zhang Jian Dong designs 36 kinds, all different styles of camel craft.
dialogue.en: In order to meet the needs of his customers, Zhang Jian Dong designs 36 kinds, all different styles of camel craft.

dialogue.text: The workshop is preparing for the national day holiday, following the autumn equinox, by making masses of model camels to sell.
dialogue.zh: 工作坊在秋分後為國慶假期準備，製作大量駱駝模型出售。
dialogue.ja: 工房は秋分の後の国慶節のために大量のラクダ模型を作って準備しています。
dialogue.local: The workshop is preparing for the national day holiday, following the autumn equinox, by making masses of model camels to sell.
dialogue.en: The workshop is preparing for the national day holiday, following the autumn equinox, by making masses of model camels to sell.

dialogue.text: Autumn is for harvest, beautiful full of life, passionate even, but this stretch of desert in Dunhuang and the camel caravans give this solar term a legendary feel.
dialogue.zh: 秋天是收穫的季節，充滿生命力和熱情，但敦煌這片沙漠和駱駝隊讓這個節氣充滿傳奇色彩。
dialogue.ja: 秋は収穫の季節で、美しく生命に満ち、情熱的ですが、敦煌のこの砂漠とラクダ隊はこの節気に伝説的な雰囲気を与えます。
dialogue.local: Autumn is for harvest, beautiful full of life, passionate even, but this stretch of desert in Dunhuang and the camel caravans give this solar term a legendary feel.
dialogue.en: Autumn is for harvest, beautiful full of life, passionate even, but this stretch of desert in Dunhuang and the camel caravans give this solar term a legendary feel.

dialogue.text: On the way back, we see the popular trees again, the wind is still whistling in my ear.
dialogue.zh: 回程中，我們再次看到那些受歡迎的樹木，風依然在耳邊呼嘯。
dialogue.ja: 帰り道で、また人気のある木々を見て、風が耳元でまだささやいています。
dialogue.local: On the way back, we see the popular trees again, the wind is still whistling in my ear.
dialogue.en: On the way back, we see the popular trees again, the wind is still whistling in my ear.

dialogue.text: It's hard to imagine how determined people had to be to travel here over 2000 years ago.
dialogue.zh: 難以想像兩千多年前的人們要多麼堅定才能來到這裡。
dialogue.ja: 2000年以上前にここに来る人々がどれほど決意を持っていたか想像しにくいです。
dialogue.local: It's hard to imagine how determined people had to be to travel here over 2000 years ago.
dialogue.en: It's hard to imagine how determined people had to be to travel here over 2000 years ago.

dialogue.text: Trading the sand sweat paths, carrying the most incredible goods, encountering hardships and obstacles, travelling from grotto to grotto, they brought riches to Dunhuang.
dialogue.zh: 他們穿越沙塵與汗水的道路，攜帶珍貴貨物，克服艱難險阻，從石窟到石窟，為敦煌帶來財富。
dialogue.ja: 砂と汗の道を行き、信じられないほどの品物を運び、困難や障害に遭遇し、石窟から石窟へと旅し、敦煌に富をもたらしました。
dialogue.local: Trading the sand sweat paths, carrying the most incredible goods, encountering hardships and obstacles, travelling from grotto to grotto, they brought riches to Dunhuang.
dialogue.en: Trading the sand sweat paths, carrying the most incredible goods, encountering hardships and obstacles, travelling from grotto to grotto, they brought riches to Dunhuang.

dialogue.text: You made this the place to do business at the autumn equinox solar term.
dialogue.zh: 你們讓這裡成為秋分節氣時做生意的地方。
dialogue.ja: あなたたちはここを秋分の節気に商売をする場所にしました。
dialogue.local: You made this the place to do business at the autumn equinox solar term.
dialogue.en: You made this the place to do business at the autumn equinox solar term.

dialogue.text: The smell of yellow sand has accompanied civilization through the millennia.
dialogue.zh: 黃沙的氣味伴隨著文明走過千年。
dialogue.ja: 黄色い砂の匂いは何千年もの間文明と共にありました。
dialogue.local: The smell of yellow sand has accompanied civilization through the millennia.
dialogue.en: The smell of yellow sand has accompanied civilization through the millennia.

dialogue.text: Here, I've seen the power and tenacity of life in the desert.
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，我見證了沙漠中生命的力量與韌性。
dialogue.ja: ここで、砂漠の生命の力と粘り強さを見てきました。
dialogue.local: Here, I've seen the power and tenacity of life in the desert.
dialogue.en: Here, I've seen the power and tenacity of life in the desert.
